en.机构简介:
Camelēr Spice Co. is a premium spice brand dedicated to bringing the world’s most captivating flavours to kitchens everywhere. Founded by British-Saudi Arabian marketeer and chef Halle and Irish business strategist Myles, the company combines cultural heritage with a commitment to sustainability and innovation. Drawing inspiration from the ancient spice routes and the wisdom of traditional spice merchants, Camelēr Spice Co. creates unique, handcrafted blends that celebrate the stories and culinary histories of regions across the globe.

Each blend is meticulously crafted, often inspired by generational recipes and carefully sourced from regenerative farms that uphold ethical practices. Packaged in eco-friendly brown glass jars, their spices not only preserve freshness but also pay homage to the age-old apothecary jars used to protect the potency of these precious ingredients. With a mission to educate and inspire, Camelēr Spice Co. strives to create a deeper appreciation for spices, empowering home cooks and chefs alike to explore and celebrate the rich, diverse heritage of global cuisine.

Videns empowers organizations by harnessing the potential of data and the latest advancements in artificial intelligence technologies. Recognized for applied AI excellence in Quebec and globally, Videns stands out for its deep understanding of business needs, providing tailored, long-lasting solutions. As a certified B Corp and Women Owned business, Videns is the partner of choice for organizations looking to shape the future with ethical, sustainable AI. At Videns, we bring a human touch to artificial intelligence.

United Repair Centre (URC) is a B2B repair business for fashion brands to put repair on the map while creating social and environmental impact collectively. The United Repair Centre has outdoor brand Patagonia as its founding partner, providing integrated clothing repair and resale solutions for fashion, apparel and workwear brands that want to create positive environmental impact and local employment opportunities for people with a distance to the labor market at the same time. We strive to make it easy for leading apparel brands in Northwestern Europe to achieve their circularity goals. We do so by offering high-quality repair services.

At the same time, we create a positive social impact by providing training and employment opportunities to newcomers with refugee backgrounds, young adults and other people who face difficulties in accessing the labor market. We demonstrate that it is possible to change the clothing industry by putting people first while creating value with textiles that otherwise would be wasted.

Pristine Washroom and Laundry Services is a London-based leader in the commercial cleaning and laundry industry, dedicated to delivering exceptional hygiene and fabric care solutions. As a forward-thinking company, we are committed to high standards of service quality, sustainability, and community impact. Our journey reflects a deep-seated commitment to environmentally responsible practices and stakeholder engagement, ensuring our clients receive services that are both effective and eco-friendly.

Award-winning, experienced HR specialists who bring expertise, innovation and integrity to everything we do.
When it comes to building an engaged and high-performing workforce, Redway HR will always have your back. Our goal is to be the partner of choice for building high-performing, engaged workforces, for organisations making a positive impact on workplaces and society.

Our expert team has a wide range of sector specialisms. We talk to you, we listen to your issues, we understand your needs and goals and tailor our services to you.

Then, we get behind your organisation, aligning with your vision and values to build a long-term relationship built on trust and respect.

Whatever your challenge, we find and implement solutions you can count on. We share the options and risks in language you understand, so you can choose the path that best meets your needs.

Transparent and flexible in our approach to billing, we work on a project-by-project basis or on twelve-month retainer, so you’ll never need to worry about long tie-ins.

With us, your people feel valued, respected and empowered, and your leaders and managers have the right team and support to deliver on ambitious targets, realising your vision.

El propósito de Agroponiente es proporcionar alimentos frescos y de calidad a los consumidores de manera sostenible, ética y consciente, contribuyendo a su bienestar y salud, mientras impulsamos el desarrollo social y económico de los agricultores y trabajadores de Almería. Comprometidos con la Agricultura Consciente.

The purpose of Agroponiente is to provide fresh, quality fruit and vegetables to consumers in a sustainable, ethical and mindful way, contributing to their well-being and health, while promoting the social and economic development of growers and employees in Almería. Committed to Mindful Agriculture.

Vier für Texas is an award-winning co-creative agency based in Frankfurt am Main. With a team of creatives, strategists, and performance marketing experts, Vier für Texas partners with clients from various industries. From brand development and integrated campaigns to social and digital content, Vier für Texas delivers impactful solutions. The agency is on a journey towards new ways of working—aligned with society and the environment, fostering collaboration that resonates beyond just business.

Como fabricantes, participamos en cada etapa de la elaboración de nuestros productos, desde el diseño y desarrollo hasta la entrega final, con el objetivo de garantizar nuestra misión y visión organizacional y la excelencia que nos caracteriza. en.机构简介: Macs Adventure is the global leader in sustainable, self-guided walking and cycling holidays, driven by a mission since 2003 to transform travel for the benefit of people and the planet. Their trips enable travellers to build meaningful connections with destinations and communities, all while minimising environmental impact. With self-guided travel growing rapidly, Macs Adventure has formalised its commitment to responsible travel through B Corp certification and its first impact report. This supports responsible scaling while upholding the highest standards in governance, social impact, and environmental care. Initiatives like developing a carbon action plan and trail restoration partnerships further their dedication to preserving beloved destinations for future generations.

Yes! We Connect supports organizations with the onboarding of new joiners. Our proven approach ensures that new joiners get to know each other in a fun and easy going way. Throughout their onboarding journey they discover how to contribute to the goals of the organization. New joiners feel seen and appreciated, which improves retention up to 33%.

Our unique and interactive tools are the building blocks for onboarding programs full of connection. Together we build a foundation of connection in your onboarding. We select the right tools and tailor make them to fit your content and branding. The real magic starts by your new joiners creating personal profiles. This way you put them in the spotlight and they can truly connect during their whole onboarding.

The result is that your newly onboarded employees exclaim: Yes! I feel connected.

Driven by a purpose to create a better society, The Social Hub is a pioneer in the hybrid hospitality industry, offering spaces where guests from all walks of life can learn, stay, work and play. With hotels located across Europe’s most dynamic cities, The Social Hub connects and creates a unique community of travellers, students, business professionals, neighbours, and more. From hotel facilities, student and extended stay rooms, co-working spaces, through to auditoriums, gyms, event spaces and a comprehensive social impact programme including its TSH Talent Foundation, The Social Hub is a place where people can connect and learn from one another, build a community and engage in unique experiences that help spark ideas and make change happen. Founded in 2012, The Social Hub is headquartered in Amsterdam and counts with more than 1,000 employees.

At Signature Market, we are driven by a mission to make healthy living accessible, affordable, and enriching for all. Founded in 2014 as Signature Snack, Signature Market has since grown into Malaysia’s trusted choice for natural and organic products, evolving into a leading lifestyle FMCG brand. Initially focused on delivering wholesome, nutritious snacks, we now offer a diverse portfolio of over 1,000 products spanning daily essentials and lifestyle needs through our 7 in-house brands, comprising Signature Market, Plant Origins, Yī, Two Tails, Bunny-U, SingMaThai, and SlimJoy. We proudly serve customers through more than 400 retail outlets and 6 Signature Market official stores across Malaysia. Our long-term vision focuses on inspiring sustainable, mindful practices that benefit both individuals and communities. Guided by our vision, we continue to set new standards for accessibility, innovation, and wellness in the marketplace. Through the teaching of conscious living, Signature Market believes that everyone deserves to live a happy & fulfilled life. Happiness starts from being healthy physically, mentally & spiritually.

Just Enough Brave is a South West England-based design and marketing consultancy proud of its commitment to social and environmental responsibility. As a proud B Corp-certified agency, they prioritize ethical, sustainable practices in every aspect of their work, creating impactful branding, digital, and marketing solutions for clients who share their vision for a better world. Just Enough Brave goes beyond conventional consultancy by integrating purpose-driven strategies that benefit both clients and the community.

Econet A/S is a Danish family-owned company that provides consulting and training in waste management and circular economy. They collaborate with both private and public entities to optimize waste sorting, minimize waste, and create more circular material flows. Econet has specialized expertise in training employees in the recycling and waste industry and in assisting companies in understanding and influencing their waste generation. They believe that it is people (and not systems) who can and must ensure circular material flows.

Yrolí Copenhagen - Supporting what is natural.
Yrolí Copenhagen is a Danish skincare brand that combines quality, simplicity, and responsibility in everything we do. Our product range spans both skincare and haircare, all crafted with a straightforward yet powerful philosophy: healthy skin requires only a few, carefully selected layers—ideally, just one. Using scientifically based methods and natural ingredients with clinically documented effects, we work to restore and strengthen the skin’s natural health and vitality, both now and for the long term.

Every Yrolí product is made with respect for nature and produced in Denmark under strict certifications, ensuring our commitment to both people and planet.

At Moo & Yoo, we are a proud family-owned business based in Scotland, crafting vegan, luxury hair and body products with sustainability at our core. As a certified B Corp, we are part of a global movement of companies committed to meeting the highest standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency. Our products are not only designed to pamper and nourish but are also made with carefully selected natural ingredients that are kind to both you and the planet.

In alignment with our mission to foster a healthier planet, we partner with One Tree Planted, planting a tree for every online purchase to support reforestation. Join us on our journey towards sustainability and conscious luxury, one eco-friendly beauty product at a time.

Purpose Social Homes is a demand-led, purpose-driven organisation dedicated to empowering and supporting individuals with learning disabilities, and/or autism, and/or physical disabilities. Our core aims are articulated by our vision being "a valuable contribution to society" and our mission of “raising the quality bar of Specialised Supported Housing".

There is a shortage of Specialised Supported Housing (SSH) in England, leaving many individuals with profound disabilities without appropriate accommodation. Financial constraints have hindered NHS, Local Authorities and Registered Housing Providers from meeting current demand, leading to higher hospitalisation rates, increased reliance on institutional services, and reduced quality of life for vulnerable adults.

We specialise in developing sustainable housing with bespoke internal and external environments that cater to the unique needs of these vulnerable individuals, enabling them to live independent and fulfilling lives within their communities. Our collaborative and person-centred approach addresses the specific needs of Residents, NHS Integrated Care Boards, Local Authority Commissioners, Support providers and Funders/Private Investors who ultimately bridge the funding gap in the Specialised Supported Housing Sector.

A Oficina Muda é uma multimarca de moda upcycling, sustentável, que reaproveita e repara peças de descarte de marcas parceiras, dando nova vida a esses produtos. Tem como objetivo, trazer soluções para os resíduos têxteis da indústria da moda com responsabilidade socioambiental, de forma inovadora, criativa, em escala e com resultados econômicos. A empresa tem como previsão até o final de 2024 gerar uma economia de cerca de 425 milhões de litros de água, evitar o descarte de 382 toneladas de resíduos têxteis e a emissão de 3.456 toneladas de CO2e, atingindo a marca de aproximadamente 1 milhão de peças ressignificadas ao longo da sua história. Além da preocupação ambiental, a Oficina Muda olha também para a sociedade. O Projeto Retalhos, em parceria com a Rede Asta, gera renda para cerca de 300 artesãs, a partir da doação de tecidos que recebemos do Grupo Soma. Desde o início deste projeto, 55 toneladas de resíduo têxtil foram transformadas em diversos produtos, gerando aproximadamente R$ 7,6 milhões, impactando positivamente a vida das artesãs. A Oficina Muda busca novas iniciativas para contribuir para um futuro melhor e mais justo. Trabalhar com propósito é motivador e inspirador. Toda muda muda o mundo.

Evolution Money is proud to be the alternative solution for those customers. Through our bespoke and personable approach, our expert team of advisors can ensure that each customer is treated as an individual.

Just like Deliveroo or Uber, but instead of ordering a takeaway or a car, you're helping an elderly person pick up their shopping, providing a youth mentoring session, or dropping off surplus food from your cupboard to a local food bank. Imagine that the opportunities are based on your exact postcode, so good deeds happen down the street or remotely. Imagine that it's all on-demand, so you can scroll these opportunities, select one right now, and instantly get up and do good.

Founded in 2020, Umiami is a food tech company specialized in plant-based alternatives to animal products.
The company has developed a unique technology to produce plant-based fillets that mimic meat in every way: taste, texture, colour, juiciness. All without any controversial additives. 

The objective? To offer a tasty alternative to help meat eaters switch to a more plant-based diet.
And by doing so, contribute to climate protection, animal welfare and improved public health.

In 2023, Umiami launched its first product on the market: a plant-based fillet alternative to chicken breast. 
Already available in 6 European countries, the company is continuing its expansion by offering a simple, tasty product that respects health and the environment. 
And this is just the beginning!
